fusions.name: Running Stitch
fusions.desc: Throws a threaded needle up to 7 tiles. It deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets, then the thread carries it to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage each. Holds 4 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Tacked in Place
fusions.desc: Throws a pin on a short thread up to 5 tiles. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and the target moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Suture
fusions.desc: Stitches your wounds shut and restores 16 health to you. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Sleeve Pin
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a pin flies at the nearest enemy within 3 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
